import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    base = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2 + p[3]*np.log(T)
    sq = np.sqrt(eps)*(p[4] + p[5]*T + p[6]*T**2 + p[7]*np.log(T))
    lin = eps*(p[8] + p[9]*T)
    return base + sq + lin

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a,b,c,d,f,g = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5]
    return a + b*T**2 + c*np.log(T) + d/T + f*np.sqrt(eps)/T + g*eps
